question.instructions: How much operational disruption is explicitly reported? Do not infer financial loss or a universal outage from silence.
criteria: Only an information request or inconvenience; no unusable function stated
A transaction, item or individual feature is affected, with no complete business stoppage stated
An essential workflow is explicitly blocked, such as processing all customer orders

standard_answer.note:
因为明确有一个具体商品受到影响：鞋子尺码错误，无法按预期使用/需要换货。
但没有提到整个业务流程被阻塞，也没有说所有订单都无法处理。
所以应选：
A transaction, item or individual feature is affected, with no complete business stoppage stated
